decisions.reason: The option likely resolved as unsuccessful after no archived presence in 2020-2021, and its closeness to the existing catalog offers little additional value to justify carrying costs.
Despite being a series, its absence from later pages signals the option value was not realized, so resources are better shifted to other projects.
The jazz reissue's value would have been demonstrated by now; without continued visibility it is unlikely to justify further shelf space.
A costly multi-disc box set with no later web presence likely failed to sell through, making carrying costs high and option value low.
Only briefly mentioned in 2019 and absent later, this compilation CD shows no sign of realized value and is easily dropped.
